metrics.label: Fixtures this matchday
metrics.description: Count of games in this Bundesliga round (same round_name season and league).

metrics.label: Home table rank
metrics.description: League table position for the home side before this matchday when standings exist.

metrics.label: Away table rank
metrics.description: League table position for the away side before this matchday when standings exist.

metrics.label: Home games in form window
metrics.description: Finished matches counted for the home team in the last five completed matchdays.

metrics.label: Away games in form window
metrics.description: Finished matches counted for the away team in the last five completed matchdays.

metrics.label: Home matchdays in window
metrics.description: Distinct completed rounds included for the home team (at most five).

metrics.label: Away matchdays in window
metrics.description: Distinct completed rounds included for the away team (at most five).

metrics.label: Home games with shot stats
metrics.description: Form-window games where shot statistics exist for the home team.

metrics.label: Away games with shot stats
metrics.description: Form-window games where shot statistics exist for the away team.

metrics.label: Home points in window
metrics.description: Sum of league points (3/1/0) over the home team form window.

metrics.label: Away points in window
metrics.description: Sum of league points over the away team form window.

metrics.label: Home points capture
metrics.description: Share of maximum points taken in the form window (points over 3 times games).

metrics.label: Away points capture
metrics.description: Share of maximum points taken in the form window for the away team.

metrics.label: Home goals per game
metrics.description: Goals scored per match in the form window for the home team.

metrics.label: Away goals per game
metrics.description: Goals scored per match in the form window for the away team.

metrics.label: Home conceded per game
metrics.description: Goals conceded per match in the form window for the home team.

metrics.label: Away conceded per game
metrics.description: Goals conceded per match in the form window for the away team.

metrics.label: Home shot share
metrics.description: Share of shots in the form window using ratio-of-sums across matches for the home team.

metrics.label: Away shot share
metrics.description: Share of shots in the form window using ratio-of-sums for the away team.

metrics.label: Home inside-box shot rate
metrics.description: Shots from inside the box divided by all shots in the form window for the home team.

metrics.label: Away inside-box shot rate
metrics.description: Shots from inside the box divided by all shots in the form window for the away team.

metrics.label: Home shot accuracy
metrics.description: Shots on target divided by all shots in the form window for the home team.

metrics.label: Away shot accuracy
metrics.description: Shots on target divided by all shots in the form window for the away team.

metrics.label: Home finishing efficiency
metrics.description: Goals divided by shots on target in the form window for the home team.

metrics.label: Away finishing efficiency
metrics.description: Goals divided by shots on target in the form window for the away team.

metrics.label: Home pass accuracy
metrics.description: Accurate passes divided by total passes in the form window for the home team.

metrics.label: Away pass accuracy
metrics.description: Accurate passes divided by total passes in the form window for the away team.

metrics.label: Home offensive link-up
metrics.description: Accurate passes divided by total shots in the form window for the home team.

metrics.label: Away offensive link-up
metrics.description: Accurate passes divided by total shots in the form window for the away team.

metrics.label: Home save rate
metrics.description: Saves divided by saves plus goals conceded in the form window for the home team.

metrics.label: Away save rate
metrics.description: Saves divided by saves plus goals conceded in the form window for the away team.
